title: Finite-limit preservation for the pushed resolution
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and i:X.Opens -> X.Etale a continuous functor whose underlying scheme functor equals open restriction [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume sheafification with abelian coefficients in the scheme universe on both sites. Then the canonical abelian sheafPullback i preserves finite limits. No cohomology-vanishing assumption is required.

source.place: Tags 072W and 0733(1), direct injective-resolution proof; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09AX; sites.tex Tags 00X5 and 00X6; extension by zero as in sites-modules.tex Tag 03DJ.

proof.text: Obtain the usual inclusion j with forgetful equality and finite-limit preservation from zariski_to_etale_is_morphism. The forgetful functor lands in Over X and is fully faithful. Thus Mathlib Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight applied to eqToIso (hi_inclusion.trans hj.symm) gives i ≅ j. Transfer finite-limit preservation along this isomorphism.

Apply Mathlib flat_of_preservesFiniteLimits to i, since X.Opens has finite limits. Apply the proved universe-general CategoryTheory.preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_of_flat (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.Flat) to abelian coefficients, using the AB5 instance from Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Grp.AB. Unfold the constructed sheafPullback and compose the preservation instances for sheafToPresheaf, i.op.lan, and presheafToSheaf with comp_preservesFiniteLimits.

proof_origin.place: Sites Tags 00X5 and 00X6; finite-limit preservation transferred by full faithfulness of Scheme.Etale.forget, followed by the proved universe-general presheaf Kan-extension lemma.
proof_origin.note: The old localization argument incorrectly treated Scheme.Etale.forget as a functor to Scheme rather than Over X. The signature is unchanged.

theorem zariski_etale_pushed_resolution_finite_limits
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)
